hero.subtitle: Uniting the rigor of industrial engineering with the agility of software development and AI. Transforming complex problems into elegant solutions.

about.title: From Chemical Engineering to Code
about.p1: I am a Chemical Engineering student at UFMG and an intern at BRASS Brasil, where I work with leak detection systems for pipelines. My journey led me to discover the power of programming as a tool to solve engineering problems more efficiently.
about.p2: Today, I combine technical engineering knowledge with Full Stack development skills, creating solutions ranging from AI automation to web applications that facilitate complex calculations.

projects.eng_desc: Projects focused on hydraulics, rheology, and process optimization.
projects.tech_desc: Modern development focused on automation and artificial intelligence.

about_page.title: From UFMG to Industry, from Excel to React
about_page.description: A journey of discovery that connects chemical engineering, software development, and artificial intelligence.
about_page.talk_p: I am always open to new opportunities, collaborations, and interesting projects. If you have an idea or opportunity, get in touch!

tech_page.title: Tech Projects
tech_page.description: Modern development with AI and automation. VibeCoding: using artificial intelligence as a partner in the creative development process.
tech_page.vibe_desc: VibeCoding is the practice of using AI as a partner in software development. Instead of writing every line of code manually, I collaborate with language models to accelerate development, maintain quality, and explore creative solutions to technical problems.

eng_page.title: Engineering Projects
eng_page.description: Experience in hydraulic systems, industrial process optimization, and technical consulting. Focus on measurable results and precision.
